name: 18V Brushless Cordless Drill Driver, 13 mm Chuck (2 x 2.0 Ah)
nameHindi: 18V ब्रशलेस कॉर्डलेस ड्रिल ड्राइवर, 13 मिमी चक (2 x 2.0 Ah)
packing: 1 kit (drill, 2 x 2.0 Ah batteries, fast charger, carry case)
shortDescription: Compact 18V brushless drill driver with 13 mm keyless chuck and 2 batteries.
description: Brushless 18V drill driver with a 13 mm keyless metal chuck, 20+1 torque settings and a built-in LED work light. Delivers up to 55 Nm for wood, steel and masonry drilling and screw driving. Supplied as a kit with two 2.0 Ah Li-ion batteries, a 1-hour charger and a carry case.

name: 20V Cordless Impact Drill Driver, 13 mm Chuck, 2-Speed (2 x 2.0 Ah)
nameHindi: 20V कॉर्डलेस इम्पैक्ट ड्रिल ड्राइवर, 13 मिमी चक, 2-स्पीड (2 x 2.0 Ah)
shortDescription: Compact 20V impact drill driver with 2-speed gearbox for fastening and drilling.
description: Compact 20V drill driver with impact mode for driving long screws and drilling into brick or timber. The two-speed gearbox and 13 mm chuck cover most workshop and site jobs. Includes two 2.0 Ah batteries and a rapid charger.

name: 800 W SDS-plus Rotary Hammer, 26 mm, 2.7 J (3 Modes)
nameHindi: 800 W SDS-प्लस रोटरी हैमर, 26 मिमी, 2.7 J (3 मोड)
packing: 1 case (hammer, side handle, depth stop, chisel and bit)
shortDescription: 800 W SDS-plus rotary hammer for concrete and masonry with chiselling mode.
description: 800 W SDS-plus rotary hammer for drilling and chiselling in concrete, brick and stone. Three modes (drill, hammer drill, chisel) with a 2.7 J impact energy and drilling capacity up to 26 mm in concrete. Supplied in a carry case with side handle and depth stop.

name: 850 W Angle Grinder 100 mm, 12,000 rpm (Side Handle, Guard)
nameHindi: 850 W एंगल ग्राइंडर 100 मिमी, 12,000 rpm (साइड हैंडल, गार्ड)
shortDescription: 850 W, 100 mm angle grinder with side handle and adjustable wheel guard.
description: 850 W angle grinder for cutting, grinding and deburring metal, tile and masonry with 100 mm discs. The slim body, spindle lock and adjustable guard make it easy to handle on site. Supplied with side handle and a wheel spanner.

name: 300 W Random Orbital Sander 125 mm with Dust Bag
nameHindi: 300 W रैंडम ऑर्बिटल सैंडर 125 मिमी, डस्ट बैग सहित
shortDescription: 300 W 125 mm random orbital sander with hook-and-loop pad and dust bag.
description: 300 W random orbital sander with a 125 mm hook-and-loop pad for fast, swirl-free finishing of wood and paint. Variable speed and an integrated dust bag keep the work surface clean. Supplied with three sanding discs.

name: 650 W Jigsaw, 65 mm Cutting Depth, Variable Speed (3 Blades)
nameHindi: 650 W जिगसॉ, 65 मिमी कटिंग डेप्थ, वेरिएबल स्पीड (3 ब्लेड)
shortDescription: 650 W variable-speed jigsaw cutting up to 65 mm in wood.
description: 650 W jigsaw with pendulum action and variable speed for clean curved and straight cuts. Cuts up to 65 mm in wood and 6 mm in steel, and the tool-free blade change speeds up jobs. Supplied with three assorted blades.

name: 1200 W Circular Saw 185 mm, 65 mm Depth of Cut (Blade Included)
nameHindi: 1200 W सर्कुलर सॉ 185 मिमी, 65 मिमी कटिंग डेप्थ (ब्लेड सहित)
shortDescription: 1200 W handheld circular saw with 185 mm blade and adjustable bevel.
description: 1200 W handheld circular saw for ripping and cross-cutting timber, boards and panels. Cuts up to 65 mm deep at 90 degrees with a bevel setting up to 45 degrees and an integrated dust port. Supplied with a 24-tooth 185 mm blade.

name: Combination Spanner Set 12 pc, 6-22 mm, Chrome Vanadium
nameHindi: कॉम्बिनेशन स्पैनर सेट 12 पीस, 6-22 मिमी, क्रोम वैनेडियम
shortDescription: 12-piece chrome vanadium combination spanner set, 6 to 22 mm.
description: Drop-forged chrome vanadium combination spanners with a 15-degree offset ring end and a polished finish. The 12-piece metric set (6, 8, 10, 12, 13, 14, 15, 17, 19, 21, 22 mm) covers everyday workshop and maintenance work. Supplied in a roll-up pouch.

name: Adjustable Wrench 6 inch (150 mm), Drop Forged, Chrome Plated
nameHindi: एडजस्टेबल रिंच 6 इंच (150 मिमी), ड्रॉप फोर्ज्ड, क्रोम प्लेटेड
shortDescription: 6 inch drop-forged adjustable wrench with a 20 mm jaw opening.
description: Drop-forged carbon steel adjustable wrench with a smooth worm-gear adjustment and a chrome-plated finish. Opens to 20 mm and is ideal for plumbing, electrical and general maintenance jobs.

name: Slip Joint Pliers 8 inch, Drop Forged, PVC-Dipped Handles
nameHindi: स्लिप जॉइंट प्लायर 8 इंच, ड्रॉप फोर्ज्ड, पीवीसी हैंडल
shortDescription: 8 inch drop-forged slip joint pliers with dipped grips.
description: Drop-forged slip joint pliers with hardened serrated jaws and a two-position pivot for gripping round and flat stock. Comfort PVC-dipped handles give a secure grip. Suitable for general workshop use.

name: Steel Measuring Tape 5 m x 19 mm, Auto-Lock, Metric/Inch
nameHindi: स्टील मेजरिंग टेप 5 मीटर x 19 मिमी, ऑटो-लॉक, मीट्रिक/इंच
shortDescription: 5 m x 19 mm steel tape with auto-lock and belt clip.
description: Pocket steel measuring tape with a 5 m x 19 mm blade printed in metric and inches. The auto-lock button holds the blade in place, and the hooked end tab and belt clip make one-handed measuring easy.

name: Hex Bolt M10 x 50 mm, Stainless Steel A2 (Box of 100)
nameHindi: हेक्स बोल्ट M10 x 50 मिमी, स्टेनलेस स्टील A2 (100 का डिब्बा)
shortDescription: Stainless steel A2 hex head bolts, M10 x 50 mm, fully threaded, box of 100.
description: Fully threaded hex head bolts in A2 (304) stainless steel for outdoor and corrosion-prone fixings. Metric M10 x 50 mm thread with 1.5 mm pitch, packed in a box of 100 pieces.

name: Hex Nut M10, Zinc Plated, Grade 8 (Box of 200)
nameHindi: हेक्स नट M10, जिंक प्लेटेड, ग्रेड 8 (200 का डिब्बा)
shortDescription: Zinc plated M10 hex nuts, grade 8, box of 200.
description: Full hex nuts in zinc-plated carbon steel for use with M10 bolts and studs. Grade 8 strength with a bright zinc finish for general engineering and construction use, supplied in a box of 200.

name: Countersunk Pozi Wood Screw 4.8 x 38 mm, Zinc Plated (Box of 500)
nameHindi: काउंटरसंक पोज़ी वुड स्क्रू 4.8 x 38 मिमी, जिंक प्लेटेड (500 का डिब्बा)
shortDescription: Zinc plated countersunk pozidriv wood screws, 4.8 x 38 mm, box of 500.
description: Countersunk Pozidriv screws with a sharp point and a deep thread for chipboard, MDF and softwood. The zinc-plated finish resists corrosion in interior use. Packed in a box of 500 for fast site restocking.

name: Nylon Frame Anchor 10 x 100 mm with Steel Screw (Pack of 50)
nameHindi: नायलॉन फ्रेम एंकर 10 x 100 मिमी, स्टील स्क्रू सहित (50 का पैक)
shortDescription: Nylon frame anchors with steel screws for door and window frames, pack of 50.
description: Long nylon frame anchors with pre-fitted zinc-plated steel screws for fixing door and window frames, battens and rails into concrete and brick. Drill a 10 mm hole, tap the anchor in and drive the screw to expand it. Pack of 50 sets.

name: Brass Elbow 90 Degree 3/4 inch BSP, Female-Male (Pack of 10)
nameHindi: ब्रास एल्बो 90 डिग्री 3/4 इंच BSP, फीमेल-मेल (10 का पैक)
shortDescription: Forged brass 90 degree elbows, 3/4 inch BSP, pack of 10.
description: Forged brass 90-degree elbows with 3/4 inch BSP threads (female one end, male the other) for water and air lines. Machined threads seal reliably with PTFE tape. Pack of 10 pieces.

name: Industrial Safety Helmet, Yellow, Ratchet Adjustment
nameHindi: इंडस्ट्रियल सेफ्टी हेलमेट, पीला, रैचेट एडजस्टमेंट
shortDescription: Yellow industrial safety helmet with adjustable harness.
description: Lightweight industrial safety helmet with a high-impact shell, 4-point textile harness and a ratchet dial for one-hand fit adjustment. Suitable for construction, factory and warehouse use. Available in yellow.

name: Clear Safety Goggles, Anti-Fog and Anti-Scratch, Indirect Vent
nameHindi: क्लियर सेफ्टी गॉगल्स, एंटी-फॉग और एंटी-स्क्रैच, इनडायरेक्ट वेंट
shortDescription: Clear polycarbonate goggles with anti-fog coating and elastic strap.
description: Wrap-around clear polycarbonate goggles with an anti-fog and anti-scratch coating and indirect ventilation. The adjustable elastic strap fits over prescription glasses. Recommended for grinding, drilling and dusty work.

name: Leather Work Gloves, Driver Style, Elasticated Wrist (Pair)
nameHindi: लेदर वर्क ग्लव्स, ड्राइवर स्टाइल, इलास्टिक कलाई (जोड़ी)
shortDescription: Grain leather driver-style work gloves with elasticated wrist.
description: Durable grain leather driver-style gloves with reinforced stitching and an elasticated wrist for a snug fit. Good all-round protection for handling, loading and general workshop tasks.

name: Leather Safety Boots, Steel Toe Cap, Oil-Resistant Sole (Pair)
nameHindi: लेदर सेफ्टी बूट, स्टील टो कैप, ऑयल-रेज़िस्टेंट सोल (जोड़ी)
shortDescription: Steel toe cap leather safety boots with slip-resistant sole.
description: Full-grain leather lace-up safety boots with a steel toe cap, padded ankle collar and oil-resistant, slip-resistant outsole. Built for warehouses, workshops and construction sites.
